issues.description: compareRevisions selects content (up to 200 000 chars) of every revision of the document, though only the two compared rows need it and the history only needs hasContent. A document with many large revisions loads megabytes per compare request.
issues.repro: Read the findMany select in compareRevisions.

issues.description: approveRevision takes the hash (resolveRevisionDocs, line 331) and the stored content (revisionContent, line 335) from two separate reads, so an edit landing between them stores content that does not match contentHash. A failing snapshot read is swallowed (.catch(() => null)) and the revision is then shown as 'approved before comparison existed'.
issues.repro: Code reading; needs a concurrent save during approval to observe.

issues.description: Spec Р1 says the stored text is 'как для отпечатка (без лишних пробелов)'; the implementation stores the trimmed raw text (line breaks and inner spaces kept). The diff ignores whitespace, so behaviour matches the intent and paragraphs stay readable; only the wording differs.
issues.repro: SELECT content FROM "PpkRevision" WHERE content IS NOT NULL;
